Maria (sec-eng): Short heads-up: planning a base-image rebuild to drop setuid bits, tighten seccomp, and attach cosign provenance. Need RBAC, KMS grants, and audit plumbing before we cutover. Target: Wed 03:00 UTC.
Raj (platform-sre): Can you list the exact KMS key resource? GCP KMS requires the builder SA to have encrypter/decrypter on the cryptoKey.
Kevin (infra): I'm good for the window. Two asks: 1) are we using GCP KMS (cloud) or a customer HSM? 2) what's the required audit retention for signing events?
Maria (sec-eng): Use GCP KMS (we already have key ring infra). Retention: staging=90d, prod=365d. We need a new minimal role image-signer for CI jobs + the signer operator.
Raj (platform-sre): I'll draft TF RBAC. Example: 
```
resource "google_project_iam_binding" "image_signer" {
  role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  members = [
    "serviceAccount:ci-image-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
    "serviceAccount:signer-operator@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
  ]
}
```
Kevin (infra): Looks good. Add a condition restricting use to the key resource and to the signing service account. Do NOT give admin or create permissions.
Maria (sec-eng): Also update audit pipeline: emit an image.sign event to central-audit with fields {kms_key_id, signer_principal, image_digest, build_id}. @Raj can you add a webhook step to the builder job?
Raj (platform-sre): Yes. I'll add a build step that POSTs to /audit-intake with a compact payload. PR will include sample payload and RBAC diff.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: base-image-rebuild -> Wed 03:00 UTC; canary=10%; rollback=true.
Nate (runtime): Runtime needs to verify cosign provenance and fallback behavior documented. If verify fails, runtime should revert to pinned base image v2.14 for 5m and surface a high-severity alert. Also include logs with verification.failure=true for downstream forensics.
Kevin (infra): Add cosign example to docs: 
```
cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/image-signer gcr.io/redwood/base:sha256-abc123
```
Plus a short rotation playbook for key compromise: steps to revoke, rotate, and re-cosign images.
Nate (runtime): I'll run canary in staging and flip the verify-fail path (remove signature / change key) to ensure the revert works. I'll post results in #eng-runtime.
Maria (sec-eng): Action items: Raj -> PR for RBAC + webhook; Kevin -> docs + rotation playbook; Nate -> canary + rollback exercises; I'll run vuln scan post-build and confirm audit events. Tag me in PRs. :thumbsup:
Raj (platform-sre): Will post PR link here when ready.
Kevin (infra): I'll prepare terraform condition snippet and emergency key revocation runbook.
Maria (sec-eng): If you hit attestation caveats (containerd vs dockerd), flag early.
Nate (runtime): noted and will review runbook. Ping me for runtime test window.
Maria (sec-eng): Keeping this thread as coordination log.
